input: Order custom stamps for my vintage mail correspondence

gold.taskTitle: Order Custom Stamps for Vintage Mail Correspondence
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to order custom-designed stamps suited to a vintage aesthetic for use in personal mail correspondence.

questions.title: What design or image should appear on the stamps?
questions.description: Understand the specific visual content the user wants on their custom stamps, such as a personal photo, monogram, illustration, or vintage-style artwork.

questions.title: Are these decorative stamps or postage-valid stamps?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user needs stamps that can actually be mailed through a postal service, or purely decorative/self-inking rubber stamps for aesthetics.

questions.title: What quantity of stamps do you need to order?
questions.description: Determine how many stamps the user requires to gauge cost, sheet size, and supplier minimums.

questions.title: Is there a specific size or shape you want for the stamps?
questions.description: Find out if the user has a preference for stamp dimensions or shape, such as square, rectangular, or die-cut.

questions.title: Do you already have artwork or need a design created?
questions.description: Establish whether the user has ready-to-use design files or needs help sourcing a designer to create vintage-style stamp artwork.

questions.title: What is your budget for this stamp order?
questions.description: Understand the user's spending limit to recommend appropriate suppliers and printing options.

questions.title: When do you need the stamps delivered by?
questions.description: Identify any deadline or event driving the order so that production and shipping timelines can be factored into supplier selection.
